entries.note: Bundle 125326 PharmR line 228: quote present (OCR renders CD20+ as CD20"). Ofatumumab is a member; 2009 CLL review, no MS data, untested correct.
Ocrevus label line 449 verbatim; model_src 761053 PharmR Study 02-082-0352: B cells down 65% and >99% at 0.05 and 10 mg/kg on Day 10. Proximal readout, paired, same holds.
125326 PharmR line 221 quote present. Monkey doses gave no MS regimen target; untested correct.

Hauser 2017 (PMID 28002679) abstract has quote; PharmR lines 2103-2104 state NOAEL 100 mg/kg. Margin same is supportable, but magnitude within_2x mislabels a ~12-fold margin; use direction_only or null. Quote is weak for 'no dose-limiting toxicity'.
Weber 2010 Ann Neurol, PMID 20641064, epub 2010-09: quote verbatim in abstract. Same abstract reports anti-CD20 exacerbated MOG p35-55 EAE; choosing the rMOG arm is a judgement (see rule_questions).

Kappos 2011 Lancet, PMID 22047971, epub 2011-10-31: quote verbatim; GdE lesions were the primary endpoint. Pairing, no untested conditions. ASCLEPIOS DOI exists (10.1056/NEJMoa1917246) but is null in patient_trials. registry_date 2017-05-11 not checked.
Torres 2022 Front Immunol, PMID 35967378, 2022-07-28: quote verbatim. Done after OPERA/ASCLEPIOS were known, so retrodiction scored retro is correct.
125326 PharmR line 214 quote present with the OCR '|'. Untested in 2009 correct.
Ocrevus label line 203 verbatim (58% vs 52%); 761053 PharmR shows infections treated with penicillin and dams dying of opportunistic infection. Same on any-infection holds.

Briumvi label line 278 and 761238 PharmR lines 407-410 (no cytokine change after repeated dosing) verified. Contra stands under the one-drug-contra rule, but the draft misses the 2017 ocrelizumab first-dose IL-6 match (see missing).
Yu 2022 (PMID 35233753) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract Methods. Untested opener at 2022 publication is correct; product_in_model true.

Quote verbatim in Yu 2022 Results. Model fit to the same pooled phase 2/3 patients after 20 mg was chosen and tested; authors say it 'confirms the dose chosen', so retrodiction and retro (not same) are right.

Kap 2010 (PMID 20739677, epub 2010-08-25) resolves; quote verbatim. Treatment from day 21 in rhMOG/CFA marmosets; HuMab 7D8 is a non-member human anti-CD20, product_in_model false. Untested 2010 correct.
Kappos 2011 (PMID 22047971) quote verbatim; GEL count is the primary endpoint. Marmoset model predates the trial and showed small MRI lesions, so paired same (not retro) holds at class level.
Matsushita 2008 JCI (PMID 18802481) resolves; quote verbatim. Peptide MOG35-55 EAE is a different system from the draft's B-cell-dependent rMOG track, so a separate model_id is justified.

Paired on the after-onset depletion arm, which predates Kappos 2011 and corresponds to treating established MS; quote verbatim, primary endpoint. Same supported; pre-induction exacerbation untestable in patients.

Hauser 2023 (PMID 36792367) quote verbatim (Discussion). Roche 2020-09-09 release confirms the analysis was presented at AAN 2019 and drove MUSETTE/GAVOTTE, so the 2019 proxy and not-retro for the high-dose question stand.

Lancet 2026 (PMID 42208560) quote and cCDP figures verified; 12-week cCDP is the primary endpoint and the paper cites the exposure analysis as rationale (stated). Roche release 2025-04-02 dates it 2025. Contra holds; magnitude 'opposite' overstates a null (HR 0.93/0.95).

missing: Safety, same track (cyno-bcell-depletion-tox), 2017 'same': the ocrelizumab monkey PK/PD study 02-082-0352 (761053 PharmR p.12, bundle line ~1101) found 'IL-6 levels were increased on SD1 at 2 hours post-dose in 15 of 16 animals', with fewer elevations after the second dose. That matches the first-infusion reactions in patients (34.3% in OPERA, Hauser 2017 PMID 28002679; Ocrevus label 5.1). It belongs before the 2022 ublituximab contra, and it shows the ublituximab study's repeat-dose-only sampling, not the species, is why no cytokines were seen.

Efficacy track missing: marmoset EAE (rhMOG/CFA) with late B-cell depletion by HuMab 7D8, a sibling human anti-CD20 that cross-reacts with marmoset CD20. Kap et al. 2010 J Immunol, doi 10.4049/jimmunol.1001393 (PMID 20739677), reported it 'halts the development of EAE'; it pairs with Kappos 2011 (ocrelizumab phase 2, 2011). Follow-up: Kap 2014 J Immunol doi 10.4049/jimmunol.1303125. product_in_model false.

Efficacy, possible earlier track (not verified this session): mouse MOG35-55 EAE with mouse anti-CD20 (Matsushita et al. 2008 JCI). Depletion before induction exacerbated EAE and depletion after onset reduced it. Mixed predictions; if added, model_first_use_year for EAE moves to 2008.
Engagement: the huCD20 transgenic mouse PK/PD in the 761053 PharmR (line 206) is a second B-cell depletion system with no track; low priority.
rule_questions: Safety: a primate study measured cytokines only after repeated dosing (ublituximab), and the class's harm is a first-infusion effect. Does 'silence on a harm the species could have shown' cover a study design that sampled outside the harm's window? Another member's monkeys did show first-dose IL-6. Under the current rules the 2022 contra stands and beats the missing 2017 ocrelizumab 'same'.

Efficacy: one paper (Weber 2010) gives opposite anti-CD20 effects in two EAE paradigms (rMOG improved, MOG p35-55 worsened). Do they count as one model with a mixed prediction, or two model_ids where only the B-cell-dependent paradigm is a class prediction? The draft chose the rMOG arm alone.

Efficacy: the class entered MS on rituximab's phase 2 (HERMES, 2008), a same-target non-member in MS patients. Is that a cross_indication or sibling-drug 'model' track, or out of scope because rituximab is not a member?
Dose: what should magnitude be for a margin_stated 'same' when the margin held with ~12-fold headroom? within_2x reads as prediction accuracy.
